column1: #  Metadata -> ABCD (Access to Biological Collection Data))

column9: comment

{"mapping_type": "conditional", "source_paths": ["Accession number"], "target_paths": ["Datasets/Dataset/Units/Unit/UnitID"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "OECD accession can be expressed as UnitID alone, or concatenated with OriginalSource/SourceID using a space or '@' separator."}

{"mapping_type": "aggregation", "source_paths": ["Other culture collection numbers"], "target_paths": ["UnitStateDomain/SpecimenUnit/SpecimenUnitHistory/PreviousUnitsText"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "Multiple external numbers can be stored as a semicolon\u2011separated string."}

{"mapping_type": "decomposition", "source_paths": ["Other culture collection numbers"], "target_paths": ["UnitStateDomain/SpecimenUnit/SpecimenUnitHistory/PreviousUnits/PreviousUnit/PreviousUnitText"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Each external number can be stored as an individual PreviousUnit element."}

{"mapping_type": "conditional", "source_paths": ["Other culture collection numbers"], "target_paths": ["UnitStateDomain/SpecimenUnit/SpecimenUnitHistory/PreviousUnits/PreviousUnit/PreviousUnitID"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "Reference to another ABCD unit using three IDs (PreviousUnitID, PreviousSourceID, PreviousSourceInstitutionID)."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Restrictions (physical object)"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/Hazard"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Maps OECD restriction on the physical specimen to the Hazard element."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Restrictions (data use)"], "target_paths": ["RecordRights/SpecificRestrictions"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "OECD data\u2011use restrictions are stored in the RecordRights element."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["type (Organism)"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/OrganismType"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "OECD organism type maps to the new OrganismType element (ABCD >1.21)."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Name"], "target_paths": ["Identifications/Identification/TaxonIdentified/ScientificName/FullScientificNameString"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Full scientific name string holds the OECD Name field."}

{"mapping_type": "decomposition", "source_paths": ["Name (atomized bacterial components)"], "target_paths": ["Identifications/Identification/TaxonIdentified/ScientificName/NameAtomized/Bacterial/*"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "When atomized data are available, map each bacterial component to the corresponding sub\u2011elements."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Infrasubspecific names"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/InfrasubspecificName"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "New element introduced in ABCD >1.20."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Status"], "target_paths": ["UnitStateDomain/SpecimenUnit/NomenclaturalTypeDesignation(s)/TypeStatus"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "OECD status maps to TypeStatus under NomenclaturalTypeDesignation."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Other names"], "target_paths": ["Identifications/IdentificationHistory"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "All alternative names are stored in the IdentificationHistory block."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Condition of growth"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/GrowthConditions"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Direct mapping to GrowthConditions element."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Form of supply"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/FormOfSupply"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Direct mapping to FormOfSupply element (new in >1.20)."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Serovar"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/Serovar"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Direct mapping to Serovar element."}

{"mapping_type": "conditional", "source_paths": ["Isolated from (organism substrate)"], "target_paths": ["UnitAssociation/*/ID"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "If the substrate itself is a Unit (organism), link via UnitAssociation ID."}

{"mapping_type": "conditional", "source_paths": ["Isolated from (organism substrate)"], "target_paths": ["Identifications/Identification/TaxonIdentified[role='Isolated from']"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "Use Identification with role attribute set to 'Isolated from' when substrate is an organism."}

{"mapping_type": "conditional", "source_paths": ["Isolated from (non\u2011organism substrate)"], "target_paths": ["Identifications/Identification/MaterialIdentified[role='Isolated from']"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "Use MaterialIdentified with role attribute when substrate is not an organism."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Geographic origin"], "target_paths": ["Gathering/GatheringSite/LocalityText"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Maps OECD geographic origin to the locality text of the gathering site."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Mutant"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/Mutant"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Direct mapping to Mutant element (new in >1.20)."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Genotype"], "target_paths": ["UnitCollectionDomain/CultureCollectionUnit/Genotype"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "Direct mapping to Genotype element (new in >1.20)."}

{"mapping_type": "direct", "source_paths": ["Literature (general)"], "target_paths": ["CultureCollectionUnitType/References/Reference"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": false, "notes": "General literature references are stored under References/Reference."}

{"mapping_type": "conditional", "source_paths": ["Literature (type strains)"], "target_paths": ["UnitStateDomain/SpecimenUnit/NomenclaturalTypeDesignation(s)/NomenclaturalReference"], "transform": {"op": "copy"}, "semantic_loss": false, "ambiguity": true, "notes": "For type strains, literature is linked via NomenclaturalReference."}
